entries.title: Exodus 30:1
segments: ¶And thou shalt make an altar to burn incense upon: [of] shittim wood shalt thou make it.

entries.title: Exodus 30:2
segments: A cubit [shall be] the length thereof, and a cubit the breadth thereof; foursquare shall it be: and two cubits [shall be] the height thereof: the horns thereof [shall be] of the same.

words.text: shall it be: and two cubits

entries.title: Exodus 30:3
segments: And thou shalt overlay it with pure gold, the top thereof, and the sides thereof round about, and the horns thereof; and thou shalt make unto it a crown of gold round about. {top: Heb. roof} {sides: Heb. walls}

entries.title: Exodus 30:4
segments: And two golden rings shalt thou make to it under the crown of it, by the two corners thereof, upon the two sides of it shalt thou make [it]; and they shall be for places for the staves to bear it withal. {corners: Heb. ribs}

words.text: [it]; and they shall be for places

entries.title: Exodus 30:5
segments: And thou shalt make the staves [of] shittim wood, and overlay them with gold.

entries.title: Exodus 30:6
segments: And thou shalt put it before the vail that [is] by the ark of the testimony, before the mercy seat that [is] over the testimony, where I will meet with thee.

entries.title: Exodus 30:7
segments: And Aaron shall burn thereon sweet incense every morning: when he dresseth the lamps, he shall burn incense upon it. {sweet incense: Heb. incense of spices}

words.text: upon it. {sweet incense: Heb. incense of spices}

entries.title: Exodus 30:8
segments: And when Aaron lighteth the lamps at even, he shall burn incense upon it, a perpetual incense before the LORD throughout your generations. {lighteth: or setteth up: Heb. causeth to ascend} {at even: Heb. between the two evenings}

words.text: . {lighteth: or setteth up: Heb. causeth to ascend} {at even: Heb. between the two evenings}

entries.title: Exodus 30:9
segments: Ye shall offer no strange incense thereon, nor burnt sacrifice, nor meat offering; neither shall ye pour drink offering thereon.

entries.title: Exodus 30:10
segments: And Aaron shall make an atonement upon the horns of it once in a year with the blood of the sin offering of atonements: once in the year shall he make atonement upon it throughout your generations: it [is] most holy unto the LORD.

entries.title: Exodus 30:11
segments: ¶And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

entries.title: Exodus 30:12
segments: When thou takest the sum of the children of Israel after their number, then shall they give every man a ransom for his soul unto the LORD, when thou numberest them; that there be no plague among them, when [thou] numberest them. {their number: Heb. them that are to be numbered}

words.text: them; that there be no plague
them. {their number: Heb. them that are to be numbered}

entries.title: Exodus 30:13
segments: This they shall give, every one that passeth among them that are numbered, half a shekel after the shekel of the sanctuary: (a shekel [is] twenty gerahs:) an half shekel [shall be] the offering of the LORD.

entries.title: Exodus 30:14
segments: Every one that passeth among them that are numbered, from twenty years old and above, shall give an offering unto the LORD.

entries.title: Exodus 30:15
segments: The rich shall not give more, and the poor shall not give less than half a shekel, when [they] give an offering unto the LORD, to make an atonement for your souls. {give more: Heb. multiply} {give less: Heb. diminish}

words.text: . {give more: Heb. multiply} {give less: Heb. diminish}

entries.title: Exodus 30:16
segments: And thou shalt take the atonement money of the children of Israel, and shalt appoint it for the service of the tabernacle of the congregation; that it may be a memorial unto the children of Israel before the LORD, to make an atonement for your souls.

words.text: ; that it may be a memorial

entries.title: Exodus 30:17
segments: ¶And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

entries.title: Exodus 30:18
segments: Thou shalt also make a laver [of] brass, and his foot [also of] brass, to wash [withal]: and thou shalt put it between the tabernacle of the congregation and the altar, and thou shalt put water therein.

entries.title: Exodus 30:19
segments: For Aaron and his sons shall wash their hands and their feet thereat:

entries.title: Exodus 30:20
segments: When they go into the tabernacle of the congregation, they shall wash with water, that they die not; or when they come near to the altar to minister, to burn offering made by fire unto the LORD:

words.text: not; or when they come near

entries.title: Exodus 30:21
segments: So they shall wash their hands and their feet, that they die not: and it shall be a statute for ever to them, [even] to him and to his seed throughout their generations.

words.text: not: and it shall be a statute
to them, [even] to him and to his seed

entries.title: Exodus 30:22
segments: ¶Moreover the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

entries.title: Exodus 30:23
segments: Take thou also unto thee principal spices, of pure myrrh five hundred [shekels], and of sweet cinnamon half so much, [even] two hundred and fifty [shekels], and of sweet calamus two hundred and fifty [shekels],

entries.title: Exodus 30:24
segments: And of cassia five hundred [shekels], after the shekel of the sanctuary, and of oil olive an hin:

entries.title: Exodus 30:25
segments: And thou shalt make it an oil of holy ointment, an ointment compound after the art of the apothecary: it shall be an holy anointing oil. {apothecary: or, perfumer}

entries.title: Exodus 30:26
segments: And thou shalt anoint the tabernacle of the congregation therewith, and the ark of the testimony,

entries.title: Exodus 30:27
segments: And the table and all his vessels, and the candlestick and his vessels, and the altar of incense,

entries.title: Exodus 30:28
segments: And the altar of burnt offering with all his vessels, and the laver and his foot.

entries.title: Exodus 30:29
segments: And thou shalt sanctify them, that they may be most holy: whatsoever toucheth them shall be holy.

words.text: them, that they may be most

entries.title: Exodus 30:30
segments: And thou shalt anoint Aaron and his sons, and consecrate them, that [they] may minister unto me in the priest's office.

words.text: them, that [they] may minister unto me in the priest's office

entries.title: Exodus 30:31
segments: And thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel, saying, This shall be an holy anointing oil unto me throughout your generations.

entries.title: Exodus 30:32
segments: Upon man's flesh shall it not be poured, neither shall ye make [any other] like it, after the composition of it: it [is] holy, [and] it shall be holy unto you.

words.text: [any other] like it, after the composition

entries.title: Exodus 30:33
segments: Whosoever compoundeth [any] like it, or whosoever putteth [any] of it upon a stranger, shall even be cut off from his people.

entries.title: Exodus 30:34
segments: And the LORD said unto Moses, Take unto thee sweet spices, stacte, and onycha, and galbanum; [these] sweet spices with pure frankincense: of each shall there be a like [weight]:

entries.title: Exodus 30:35
segments: And thou shalt make it a perfume, a confection after the art of the apothecary, tempered together, pure [and] holy: {tempered...: Heb. salted}

entries.title: Exodus 30:36
segments: And thou shalt beat [some] of it very small, and put of it before the testimony in the tabernacle of the congregation, where I will meet with thee: it shall be unto you most holy.

words.text: with thee: it shall be unto you most

entries.title: Exodus 30:37
segments: And [as for] the perfume which thou shalt make, ye shall not make to yourselves according to the composition thereof: it shall be unto thee holy for the LORD.

words.text: to yourselves according to the composition
thereof: it shall be unto thee holy

entries.title: Exodus 30:38
segments: Whosoever shall make like unto that, to smell thereto, shall even be cut off from his people.

words.text: thereto, shall even be cut off
